title: Origami cup from one square sheet

steps.detail: Fold one corner to the opposite corner and crease. Turn it so the long folded edge is at the bottom and the point is at the top.

faq.q: which way should the point face

steps.detail: Fold the right corner across so its tip touches the left edge. The top edge of this flap should be level.

faq.q: how far do i fold it

steps.detail: Fold the left corner across the front so its tip touches the right side.
Fold only the front layer of the top point down toward you and tuck it into the pocket.

faq.q: how many layers do i fold

steps.detail: Turn the cup over and fold the remaining top flap down the same way.
Gently push the sides so the mouth opens.
